fields.cluster_test_content: Your mental health is important for overall health and well-being. It affects how you feel, think, and behave. Good mental health allows you to cope with daily stressors and challenges and enjoy your life. Sometimes, life can get tough, and you may find yourself feeling stressed or sad. These are normal reactions, but sometimes it affects your day-to-day functioning. That is when you need professional support and it is okay to ask for help.
fields.cluster_test_disclaimer: Please respond to all the questions. Your responses will help us determine the status of your mental health and safe interventions will be provided as per your need and convenience. Information will be handled with the highest level of integrity and confidentiality.
